summary: Preserve destructive-operation confirmation, side-effect-free dry runs, safe snapshot handling, typed provisioning, truthful partial-failure exits, complete report sync, and reliable MCP path binding.
reason: Local review found safety and correctness gaps that could mutate a PBX unexpectedly, expose secrets, hide partial failures, or return incomplete novel-command results.
validated_outcome: Focused regression tests cover confirmation classification, local-only search, private snapshots, typed CSV fields, queue-source preservation and windows, import/tail failures, OAuth timeout, safe retries, dry-run redaction, and MCP path binding.
